It is the second wave of a larger wave 3: five waves up from Apr 4, 2025 to Oct 15, 2025 and a pullback of 0.77 of them to the Nov 14, 2025 low came first, so the end of this wave 2 starts wave 3 of 3, the strongest move a chart makes.
